title: AI cover letter: personal reasons and verified experience
description: Connect your real experience with the job requirements. Use AI to draft a clear cover letter you can review and edit before sending.
heading: A cover letter with a specific reason.

sections.heading: Answer three questions first
sections.html: Why this role? Why this company? Which verified experience makes you a good match? Write these answers in your own words to avoid a letter that could be sent to any employer.

sections.heading: Use a clear structure
sections.html: Name the role in the subject. Start with a specific connection to the opportunity, support your fit with a verifiable example, and end with an invitation to discuss your application. Do not estimate metrics or invent contact names.

sections.heading: Cover letter or motivation letter?
sections.html: A cover letter focuses on suitability for the role. A separate motivation letter can give more space to personal reasons, career goals or a change of direction. Submit both only when appropriate for the employer’s instructions.

sections.heading: Check before sending
sections.html:
• Verify the company, position and greeting.
  • Check every experience against your resume or confirmed profile.
  • Replace all placeholders.
  • Attach the correct resume and cover letter.
  • Verify the recipient address.

Candidaro prepares an email draft. You review and send it yourself.
